Construct and Validate a BOLD API Query

bold_get_query.Rd

Takes vector or list inputs for available BOLD API scopes, formats them, and validates them against the BOLD API preprocessor to return a formal query string of triplets.

Usage

bold_get_query(
  tax = NULL,
  bin = NULL,
  geo = NULL,
  inst = NULL,
  recordsetcode = NULL,
  ids = NULL,
  max_chars = 240
)

Arguments

tax

Taxonomic ranks (e.g., kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, subfamily, tribe, genus, species, subspecies). Accepts a character vector or list.

bin

Barcode Index Number (BIN) URIs. Accepts a character vector or list.

geo

Geopolitical divisions (e.g., country/ocean, province/state, region). Accepts a character vector or list.

inst

Institution names or sequence sites. Accepts a character vector or list.

recordsetcode

Dataset codes. Accepts a character vector or list.

ids

Specimen or sequence IDs (processid, sampleid, insdcacs). Accepts a character vector or list.

max_chars

Integer. Maximum character length per preprocessor request chunk. Default is 240.

Value

Invisibly returns a character string of semicolon-separated validated query triplets.

Details

The function accepts multiple search criteria to dictate the aggregate data and barcodes returned. Criteria can be combined to allow for different results:

  • Same Scope: Criteria sharing the same scope combine results into a single result (implicit logical OR).

  • Different Scopes: Criteria of different scopes apply an overlap constraint (implicit logical AND).

For example, searching for tax "Aves" and geo "Argentina" returns barcodes that overlap on both the taxonomic and geographic criteria.

See also
